data.title: Muthoot Microfin Raises ₹250 Crore via NCDs to Support Growth and Lower Funding Costs
data.description:
Muthoot Microfin Ltd ( (IN:MUTHOOTMF) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Muthoot Microfin Ltd. has raised ₹250 crore via a private placement of listed, rated, secured and redeemable non-convertible debentures, which will be listed on BSE Limited. The issuance comprises 2,50,000 debentures of ₹10,000 each, with a 24‑month tenure and a 9.25% annual coupon payable monthly, and is backed by a first‑ranking exclusive charge over the company’s receivables.

The fund raise is part of the company’s strategy to strengthen its funding profile, diversify its liability mix and reduce borrowing costs, following a 75‑basis‑point decline in its cost of funds in FY26. Supported by a recent credit rating upgrade to CRISIL AA‑/Stable, the transaction underscores investor confidence and is expected to help Muthoot Microfin improve margins while pursuing responsible growth and expanding its customer base across its markets.
